verdict.rationale: Asaas documents its own built-in background automations: automatic charge reminders before and after the due date over WhatsApp, email, SMS or voice robot; set-once invoice (nota fiscal) automation; recurring subscriptions; and recurring Automatic Pix. These are fixed billing workflows rather than general, user-defined or AI-driven automations. The MCP server only lets an assistant query documentation, so it does not let an agent take actions. missing for 10: user-configurable general automation/workflow builder, agent- or AI-driven autonomous task execution, scheduling/trigger configuration beyond billing presets, independent or hands-on corroboration.
